## #13 — tg_jp — 2011-08-02
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/7169/post-62298>

[[QUOTE:  healewis said: Hi I'm managing to work through the blow particle effect and have even gone as far as to add extra blow particles However, I'm confused as to why my particle array properties panel is ]]

hi, thank you for using it.

your particle object at the post seems to be a raw particle object ( you can convert this type from other particle objects by double clicking object icon at object browser ). you cannot make back to original particle object ( array, mesh, or script ) after converting raw particle object.

try to add new particle array object for your project. and don't do double click object icon at object browser.  

regards.

tg_jp, Hiroto.
